judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The element is the header search box (input type=search, placeholder "Buscar..."), whose placeholder is its only visible label and also its accessible name. Claim: the snapshot records the placeholder at #bbbbbb (from CSS) on the white field, 14px/400, measured 1.92:1; the screenshot crop shows faint grey "Buscar..." text on white, and the live style.css confirms input[type="search"]::placeholder { color: #bbb } with form { background:#fff }, which computes to 1.92:1, so the sentence holds. Element: the placeholder is visible text that conveys the field's purpose, is not part of an inactive control, logo or decoration, and at 14px normal weight needs 4.5:1; W3C's WAI forms tutorial notes that default placeholder colours fail the WCAG minimum and recommends #767676 on white, so this placeholder fails 1.4.3 for the reason the claim gives. Capture: the live HTML and CSS fetched now carry the same markup and colours; at the captured 1280px width #sfield is shown (it is hidden only at 1200px and below, where a sidenav search with the same placeholder style takes over), so nothing that differs touches the claim.
